SELECT 
                DD.DateSk,
				CONVERT(varchar(12), CurrencyConversionTimestamp, 112) CurrencyConversionTimestamp, 
				ConvertFromCurrencyId, 
				ConversionRate 
			FROM 
                EDS.DATE_DIM DD
            LEFT JOIN
				BNKM.CurrencyConversion CC
                ON
                (CASE WHEN BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG ='N' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12),DD.Previous_Business_Day, 112) ELSE DD.DateSk END)=CONVERT(varchar(12), CurrencyConversionTimestamp, 112)

			WHERE 
                ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' 
				AND RateId = 'REV' 
				AND FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01'
                and WEEKDAY IN (1,7)

                SELECT * FROM    EDS.DATE_DIM
